subject: [PATCH 3/6] mm/vma: only permit MAP_PRIVATE /dev/zero to be mapped anonymous

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the potential security implications of restricting MAP_PRIVATE /dev/zero mappings and asked for clarification on why this is considered 'dangerous'.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Clarified that the exception for MAP_PRIVATE /dev/zero mappings is a historical artifact and that eliminating this edge case would improve maintainability and security. Suggested that userland should allocate memory and drivers use GUP to access it.

2026-09-07.patch_summary: Patch aims to restrict MAP_PRIVATE /dev/zero mappings to be anonymous, but raises concerns about edge cases and potential security implications.
